name: Strahd Von Zarovich
description: Count Strahd Von Zarovich is the ancient vampire lord and undisputed ruler of Barovia.
dm_notes:
Once a powerful conquering warlord of the Von Zarovich dynasty, Strahd made a dark pact with Shorthagot to gain immortality after becoming consumed by jealousy over his brother Sergei's betrothal to Tatyana. He murdered Sergei at their wedding and pursued Tatyana, who threw herself from the walls of Castle Ravenloft rather than submit to him. The Dark Powers of the Shadowfell sealed Barovia in mist as his eternal prison. Strahd is a brilliant tactician, a skilled wizard, and a predator who toys with those trapped in his domain. He views the party as potential entertainment — or threats to be crushed. 

 Over the Centuries he has slowly gotten more and more cruel, to the point even his most Loyal servants are starting to fear him..

name: Ireena Kolyana
description: Ireena Kolyana is the adopted daughter of the late Burgomaster Kolyan Indirovich and the sister of Ismark.
dm_notes:
Unknown to her, she is the latest reincarnation of Tatyana, the woman Strahd loved and lost centuries ago. Strahd has bitten her twice, and she bears the marks on her neck, though she makes sure to have them covered with a scarf at all times. Ireena is brave, compassionate, and determined not to become Strahd's prisoner. She is skilled with a sword and refuses to be treated as a helpless victim.

Ireena's true origins: She was born to a Barovian family living near the Svalich Woods. As a young child, a dire wolf attack scattered her family — she was separated from her biological brother Izek during the chaos. The young Ireena was found wandering alone at the edge of the woods by Burgomaster Kolyan Indirovich, who took her in and raised her as his own daughter alongside his biological son Ismark. She has no memory of her life before Kolyan's home and does not know she is adopted.

Her biological brother Izek Strazni survived the same attack but lost part of his arm to the wolves. He was eventually taken in by the Vallakovich household in Vallaki and grew into the Baron's loyal captain of the guard. Izek is obsessed with Ireena's likeness — commissioning dolls from Blinsky that resemble her — but does not consciously understand why. Neither sibling knows the truth of their connection.

Ireena's name 'Kolyana' is a Barovian patronymic meaning 'daughter of Kolyan,' reflecting her adoptive father rather than any biological family surname.

The party's efforts to protect her from Strahd are central to the campaign.

associations.name: Ireena Kolyana

associations.name: Doru

associations.name: Father Donavich
associations.relationship: Father Donavich blessed the reformed Village Militia and serves as second in command and healer.

name: Ismark Kolyanovich
description: Ismark Kolyanovich, once known unkindly as 'Ismark the Lesser,' is the son of the late Burgomaster Kolyan Indirovich and Ireena's brother. A capable warrior and a man of honor, Ismark now leads the reformed Village Militia — the Barovian contingent — alongside his old friend Doru. With nearly 75 men and women under their command and Father Donavich's blessing, Ismark has finally stepped out of his ancestor's shadow.
dm_notes:
Ismark carries the unflattering nickname due to the villagers' perception that he cannot live up to his ancestor Ismark the Great. In an effort to protect Ireena, he and many of the able-bodied fighters joined Mordenkainen in an assault on Castle Ravenloft. The attack ended with Strahd being wounded, but not before Mordenkainen was thrown from the Castle walls and the remaining villagers were slaughtered. Only Ismark, Doru, and a handful of others managed to escape, and most of them were badly wounded.

Ismark grew up close to the Vallakovich family in Vallaki — his father Kolyan and Baron Vallakovich were old friends, and Ismark and Ireena attended the Festival of Light as honoured guests. This is why Ismark was certain Ireena would find safety in Vallaki, as the Vallakoviches watched both of them grow into the adults they are today.

When Doru was healed of his vampirism, he reached out to Ismark to reform the Village Militia. Ismark was all too eager — he had received word from his sister Ireena in Vallaki that the fight against Strahd was building momentum. With Father Donavich blessing the new militia and serving as cleric, the two men recruited nearly 75 men and women to join. Ismark leads the Barovian contingent overall, with Father Donavich as second in command and healer, and Doru commanding the foot soldiers.

Ismark would not hesitate to join the party in fighting Strahd.

associations.relationship: Luvash is a Vistani leader of the Tser Hill Vistani and is under Madam Eva's broader spiritual authority.

associations.name: Arrigal
associations.relationship: Arrigal is a Vistani who serves as one of Strahd's spies, operating within the Vistani community Madam Eva leads. Madam Eva was suspicious of Arrigal's loyalties.

name: Madam Eva
description: Madam Eva is the ancient leader of the Vistani encampment at Tser Pool and one of the most powerful seers in all the realms. She uses her Tarokka deck to divine the future and guide those who seek her counsel. Her readings are cryptic but always prove true. She is far older than she appears.
dm_notes: Madam Eva harbors deep secrets about her connection to Barovia's dark lord. Despite the Vistani's traditional service to Strahd, she appears to work toward his downfall for reasons of her own. Her Tarokka readings guided the party to the locations of powerful artifacts that can aid in the fight against Strahd.

associations.name: Ezmerelda d'Avenir
associations.relationship: Ezmerelda is Van Richten's former student. They parted ways due to a disagreement but she came to Barovia searching for him.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich

associations.name: Rudolph d'Avernir
associations.relationship: Van Richten's alias used at the Wizard Tower. The party met him under this identity in Session 20.

name: Rudolph Van Richten
description: Dr. Rudolph Van Richten is the legendary vampire hunter who has spent decades tracking and destroying undead across the multiverse. He operates in Barovia under the disguise of Rictavio, a flamboyant carnival ringmaster, to avoid detection by Strahd's spies. Van Richten is methodical, experienced, and utterly dedicated to destroying Strahd.
dm_notes:
Van Richten carries deep guilt over the Vistani curse placed on him after a tragic incident involving his son, Erasmus. The party met him at the Wizard Tower in Session 20 under the name Rudolph d'Avernir.

He knows Mordenkainen from his previous adventures and considers him one of his oldest and closest friends. He thinks of Ezmerelda as a daughter and vowed to destroy Strahd and the Stormraven Sisters to avenge the death of her family. His true identity as a monster hunter is a closely guarded secret — he goes to great lengths to maintain the Rictavio persona in public. He is a valuable ally, providing knowledge, resources, and combat prowess.

associations.name: Rudolph Van Richten
associations.relationship: Ezmerelda's mentor and teacher. She came to Barovia searching for him after they parted ways.

associations.name: Velinka d'Avenir
associations.relationship: A member of the d'Avenir family connected to the monster hunting legacy.

name: Ezmerelda d'Avenir
description: Ezmerelda d'Avenir is a young Vistani monster hunter who came to Barovia searching for her mentor. She is resourceful, fearless, and carries an arsenal of monster-hunting equipment. She lost her right leg below the knee to a werewolf and wears a prosthetic. Despite her youth, she is one of the most capable hunters in Barovia.
dm_notes: Ezmerelda is the former student of Rudolph Van Richten. They parted ways due to a disagreement, but she came to Barovia searching for him after learning he had entered the domain. Her connection to Van Richten and her Vistani heritage give her unique insights into both the supernatural threats and the political landscape of Barovia.

associations.name: Oskander

associations.name: Mad Mary Strazni

associations.name: Gertruda

name: Rahadin
description: Rahadin is Strahd's loyal chamberlain and right hand, a dusk elf who serves the Von Zarovich family with absolute devotion. He is surrounded by a deathly aura — the screaming phantoms of his countless victims follow him everywhere. Rahadin is an exceptionally skilled warrior and considers himself the count's most faithful servant.
dm_notes:
Rahadin betrayed his own people to serve Strahd and orchestrated the genocide of the female dusk elves on Strahd's orders, earning the eternal hatred of the surviving dusk elf community. He personally mutilated Kasimir Velikov by cutting off his ears as punishment for protesting. Rahadin has served the Von Zarovich family for centuries and views any threat to Strahd as a personal affront.

Rahadin murdered Oskander — one of the five magical duplicates of the wizard Yuri Skander — in a fit of rage. Nobody is certain what their fight was about or why Rahadin killed him. Oskander had married Mary Strazni (Yuri's former apprentice) and they had a young daughter, Gertruda. His death devastated Mary, who left Vallaki and returned to the Village of Barovia where she became known as Mad Mary. Gertruda later naively traveled to Castle Ravenloft — ironically the home of Rahadin's master, Strahd.

Once word of Oskander's murder reached the other Skanders — Yuri, Iskander, Askander, Uskander, and Eskander — they vowed never to forgive Strahd. The entire Skander family, all powerful wizards, now harbor a deep hatred for Strahd and his servants. Rahadin's impulsive act of violence created a powerful bloc of enemies in Vallaki that Strahd may not even be aware of.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Baba Lysaga is obsessed with Strahd, believing herself to be his true mother. She has extended her life to watch over him.

name: Baba Lysaga
description: Baba Lysaga is an ancient, powerful witch who dwells in the ruins of Berez in a creeping hut perched on an enormous tree stump. She commands swarms of insects and scarecrows, and her magic rivals that of the most powerful spellcasters. Lysaga has lived for centuries, extending her life through dark magic.
dm_notes: Baba Lysaga is obsessed with Strahd, believing herself to be his true mother. She has extended her life through dark magic for centuries to watch over him. She destroyed the village of Berez long ago in retaliation for the villagers' actions against one of Tatyana's reincarnations. Her devotion to Strahd is absolute and she will destroy anyone she perceives as a threat to him.

associations.name: Rahadin
associations.relationship: Rahadin mutilated Kasimir by cutting off his ears as punishment for protesting against Strahd.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Kasimir's sister Patrina agreed to become Strahd's bride, leading to tragedy for the dusk elf community.

name: Kasimir Velikov
description: Kasimir Velikov is the leader of the dusk elves who live alongside the Vistani near Vallaki. He bears terrible scars — his ears were cut off as punishment for an act of defiance. Kasimir is haunted by visions and carries a deep, quiet grief for the losses his people have suffered. He Leads the Night Rangers, a group of dusk elf rangers who protec the Vistani and his people.
dm_notes: Kasimir's ears were cut off by Rahadin on Strahd's orders. He is haunted by visions sent by his dead sister Patrina, a dusk elf who was stoned to death by her own people when she agreed to become Strahd's bride. Kasimir seeks the Amber Temple to find the means to resurrect Patrina, unaware that her spirit has been corrupted by dark powers. His quest to the Amber Temple can serve as a major plot hook. Kasimir knows of the power located in the anicent ruins beneath the Amber Temple and that it was where Strahd had made his pact with Shorthagot. He believes that if he can access that power, he may be able to save his sister's soul and restore his people. Until this he will do what ever is necessary to avenge them and kill Rahadin, even if it means working with the adventurers or making a deal with Strahd himself.

associations.name: Kolyan Indirovich
associations.relationship: Kolyan was one of Baron Vallakovich's closest friends among the Barovian burgomasters. They often attended each other's festivals and shared counsel on protecting their people.

name: Baron Vargas Vallakovich
description: Baron Vargas Vallakovich is the burgomaster of Vallaki and a fair but firm leader who strives to bring light and joy to his people despite the ever-present shadow of Strahd. His motto is 'All will be well!' and he organizes the annual Festival of Light — a beloved celebration that draws honoured guests from across Barovia's towns. He rules with a steady hand and is fiercely protective of Vallaki's citizens.
dm_notes:
Baron Vallakovich genuinely wants what is best for his people, but feels he must walk on eggshells to keep Strahd from taking notice of his small town. He tries to bring as much light and joy to Vallaki as possible while maintaining a firm hand on governance. His wife, Baroness Lydia, is a gracious hostess who helps organize the Festival of Light. Lady Fiona Wachter is a close friend and political ally of the family.

The Baron is close friends with the burgomasters of the other towns in Barovia. He and Kolyan Indirovich were particularly close — the Indirovich children, Ismark and Ireena, often attended the Festival of Light as honoured guests of the Vallakovich household. The Baron watched both of them grow into the adults they are today, which is why Ismark was certain Ireena would find safety in Vallaki.

When Strahd attacked the Festival of Light, it shattered the peace the Baron had worked so hard to build. Lady Fiona Wachter's youngest child, Stella Wachter, was killed in the attack. Stella's death devastated the Wachter family and hardened Fiona's resolve against Strahd.

associations.name: Baron Vargas Vallakovich
associations.relationship: Fiona is a close friend and ally of the Vallakovich family. The two houses have supported each other in Vallaki for years.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Fiona holds a neutral stance toward Strahd — neither serving nor opposing him. After Strahd's attack on the Festival of Light killed her daughter, her neutrality has turned to cold fury.

associations.name: Nikolai Wachter Jr.
associations.relationship: Fiona's eldest son. Commands militia in the Order of the Silver Dragon contingent. Fond of wine and trouble.

associations.name: Karl Wachter
associations.relationship: Fiona's second-born son. A bookworm like his father Nikolai. Feels responsible for Stella's death.

associations.name: Stella Wachter
associations.relationship: Fiona's youngest child and only daughter. Killed at the Festival of Light. Stella was following in Fiona's Narfell footsteps and showed promise as a Demon Master.

name: Lady Fiona Wachter
description: Lady Fiona Wachter is a Vallakian noblewoman and a respected figure in Vallaki's political life. She is a close friend and ally of the Vallakovich family. Fiona is politically savvy, charming when she needs to be, and deeply devoted to her family. She carries herself with an air of quiet authority and is known for her sharp mind and unwavering composure.
dm_notes:
Lady Fiona practices demon worship and the occult as part of her Narfell faith — an ancient tradition she keeps privately but does not hide from those she trusts. She holds a neutral stance toward Strahd, neither serving him nor actively opposing him, viewing survival and pragmatism as the wisest course in Barovia.

Fiona is a close friend of the Vallakovich family and would never harm them. She keeps the preserved corpse of her dead husband Nikolai in her bedroom — maintained with Gentle Repose as a product of her Narfell beliefs about death and the spirit world. Nikolai was a serious historian who built the famous Wachterhaus library over decades, discussing ancient histories and lost languages with Strahd himself over wine. He was killed over a decade ago while traveling to investigate Netherese ruins near Mount Ghakis — the common story says werewolves, but nobody truly knows.

Fiona has two sons — Nikolai Jr. and Karl — and had a daughter, Stella, the youngest. Nikolai Jr. is fond of wine and trouble but commands the militia. Karl is a bookworm like his father. Stella was following in Fiona's Narfell footsteps and was already showing promise as a Demon Master.

When Strahd attacked the Festival of Light, Stella was killed by minions of Lady Williams. This devastating loss shattered Fiona's neutral stance toward the vampire lord. Karl tried to protect his younger sister but couldn't — he carries the guilt of her death. Fiona's grief has hardened into a quiet, burning rage toward Strahd — she may prove a powerful ally to anyone who seeks to bring him down, driven not by politics but by a mother's fury.

associations.relationship: Izek commissions Blinsky to craft dolls resembling Ireena, though he can't explain his obsession.

name: Izek Strazni
description: Izek Strazni is the captain of the guard in Vallaki and Baron Vallakovich's most trusted protector. He has a monstrous, oversized arm wreathed in barbs that can conjure fire — the result of a mysterious transformation during childhood. Izek is intimidating and fiercely loyal to the Baron, using his fearsome presence to keep order in the town.
dm_notes:
Izek is secretly obsessed with Ireena Kolyana, commissioning the toymaker Blinsky to craft dolls in her likeness, though he doesn't understand why he feels drawn to her. Izek is Ireena's biological brother, separated in childhood.

Izek's true origins: He and Ireena were born to a Barovian family living near the Svalich Woods. As young children, a dire wolf attack devastated their family. During the chaos, Izek lost part of his arm to the wolves and was separated from his younger sister. Ireena was found by Burgomaster Kolyan Indirovich and raised in the Village of Barovia, while Izek wandered alone until he was eventually taken in by the Vallakovich household in Vallaki.

Izek's monstrous arm — an oversized, barbed limb capable of conjuring fire — grew back through unknown means, possibly connected to a dark gift or fiendish pact. The transformation happened during his youth in Vallaki and cemented his role as the Baron's protector, since no one dared challenge someone with such terrifying power.

Izek is obsessed with a face he sees in his dreams — Ireena's face — though he has no conscious memory of his sister. He commissions the toymaker Gadof Blinsky to craft dolls in her likeness, filling his room with dozens of them. If Izek ever encounters Ireena, he will become fixated on her and may try to take her by force, believing she belongs with him. He does not understand the familial bond driving his obsession.

Izek's surname 'Strazni' is not a patronymic — it may have been given to him by the Vallakovich household or adopted from another source, further severing his connection to his biological family.

Despite his loyalty to the Baron and his role as Vallaki's protector, Izek has a volatile temper and can be dangerously unpredictable when provoked. His obsession with the dolls reveals a broken, deeply human need for connection to the family he lost.

associations.name: Izek Strazni
associations.relationship: Izek secretly commissions Blinsky to create dolls that look like Ireena.

associations.name: Rudolph Van Richten
associations.relationship: Blinsky received his pet monkey Piccolo as a gift from Rictavio (Van Richten's disguise).

name: Gadof Blinsky
description: Gadof Blinsky is Vallaki's eccentric toymaker whose motto is 'Is no fun, is no Blinsky!' Despite the grim nature of Barovia, Blinsky remains relentlessly cheerful and creates toys that are invariably creepy and macabre — headless dolls, coffin-shaped music boxes, and worse. He is accompanied by his pet monkey, Piccolo, a gift from Rictavio.
dm_notes: Blinsky has been secretly commissioned by Izek Strazni to create dolls that look like Ireena Kolyana, though the toymaker doesn't understand the reason behind the requests. Blinsky is innocent in the arrangement — he simply fills the orders and accepts payment. The dolls are a key clue to the connection between Izek and Ireena.

associations.name: Doru
associations.relationship: Doru is Father Donavich's son, turned into a vampire spawn and locked in the church undercroft.

name: Father Donavich
description: Father Donavich is the priest of the church in the Village of Barovia. Once a broken man whose faith was shattered by his son's vampiric curse, Donavich has been renewed by Doru's miraculous healing. He blessed the reformed Village Militia and now serves as its second in command and healer, his faith in the Lord of Light restored.
dm_notes:
Donavich's faith was shattered when his son Doru returned from the assault on Castle Ravenloft as a vampire spawn. He kept Doru locked in the church undercroft, praying desperately for divine intervention. He eventually discovered a cure for the vampirism, but it would only take permanent effect if the vampire that bit Doru — Seraphine Stormraven — was slain. When the party killed Seraphine at the Battle of Tser Pool, Doru was fully healed and Donavich's faith was restored.

With new life and renewed faith in the Lord of Light, Donavich blessed the reformed Village Militia that his son Doru and Ismark Kolyanovich built together. He now serves as the militia's second in command and healer, providing spiritual guidance and divine support to the nearly 75 men and women who answered the call. Donavich is a changed man — no longer the haggard, sleepless wreck he once was, but a cleric with purpose and fire in his heart.

associations.name: Father Donavich
associations.relationship: Doru's father. Now that Doru is healed, Donavich blessed the new Village Militia and serves as its cleric.

associations.name: Ismark Kolyanovich
associations.relationship: Doru's old friend. Together they reformed the Village Militia after Doru was healed. Ismark leads the Barovian contingent while Doru commands the foot soldiers.

associations.name: Seraphine Stormraven
associations.relationship: Seraphine bit Doru during the assault on Castle Ravenloft, turning him into a vampire spawn. Her death was the cure that freed him.

name: Doru
description: Doru is Father Donavich's son, once cursed as a vampire spawn but now healed after the death of Seraphine Stormraven. Freed from his torment, Doru reached out to his old friend Ismark Kolyanovich to reform the Village Militia that was destroyed during the assault on Castle Ravenloft. With Father Donavich's blessing, the two men recruited nearly 75 men and women to join. Doru now commands the foot soldiers of the Barovian contingent.
dm_notes:
Doru was transformed into a vampire spawn after joining a group of villagers who stormed Castle Ravenloft. During the assault, Seraphine Stormraven bit him, turning him into a vampire spawn. He was sent home to torment his father, who kept him chained in the church undercroft for months. Father Donavich discovered a cure — but it would only take permanent effect if the vampire that bit Doru was slain. When the party killed Seraphine Stormraven at the Battle of Tser Pool, the curse was broken and Doru was fully healed.

Once restored, Doru wasted no time. He reached out to his old friend Ismark, who was all too eager to act — Ismark had received word from his sister Ireena in Vallaki that the fight against Strahd was building momentum. With Father Donavich blessing the new militia and serving as its cleric, Doru and Ismark recruited nearly 75 men and women from the Village of Barovia to join. Doru now commands the foot soldiers while Ismark leads the Barovian contingent overall, with Father Donavich as second in command and healer.

Doru is a changed man — the months of torment as a vampire spawn have hardened him, and he fights with the desperate fury of someone who knows exactly what Strahd's darkness can do to a person.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Morgantha and her coven operate within Strahd's domain, preying on the desperate people of Barovia.

associations.name: Luvash
associations.relationship: Morgantha's coven kidnapped Luvash's young daughter from the Village of Barovia to grind her life force into dream pastries. This act led the party to Old Bonegrinder.

associations.name: Bella Wormwiggle
associations.relationship: Morgantha's daughter. Bella handles the grinding and preparation of the dream pastries at Old Bonegrinder.

associations.name: Offalia Wormwiggle
associations.relationship: Morgantha's granddaughter. The youngest and most sadistic member of the coven.

name: Morgantha Wormwiggle
description: Morgantha appears as an old woman who travels the roads near the Village of Barovia, selling sweet-smelling 'dream pastries' from a cart. The pastries are wildly popular among the desperate people of Barovia, granting vivid, happy dreams that provide temporary escape from the domain's misery. She operates out of the Old Bonegrinder windmill with her daughter and granddaughter.
dm_notes:
Morgantha is a night hag and the matriarch of the Bonegrinder coven. Her daughter Bella Wormwiggle and granddaughter Offalia Wormwiggle complete the hag coven. The dream pastries are made from the life force of kidnapped children — a horrific cost hidden behind the addictive treats. The coven disguises themselves as old women to move freely among the villagers.

Morgantha's coven kidnapped Luvash's young daughter from the Village of Barovia to grind her life force into dream pastries. This act led the party to Old Bonegrinder during Sessions 17-18.

associations.name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym
associations.relationship: Godfrey serves under Vladimir's command but disagrees with his refusal to allow Strahd's destruction.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Vladimir's burning hatred for Strahd keeps him trapped as a revenant. He ironically opposes Strahd's destruction, wanting him to suffer eternally.

name: Vladimir Horngaard
description: Vladimir Horngaard is the former commander of the Order of the Silver Dragon, now a revenant consumed by hatred. He and his knights once fought against Strahd but were defeated. Rather than finding peace, Vladimir's burning hatred keeps him and his fellow knights trapped as revenants in the ruined mansion of Argynvostholt.
dm_notes:
Ironically, Vladimir now opposes anyone who would destroy Strahd — believing the vampire deserves to suffer eternally in his prison of Barovia rather than finding release through death. This makes him an obstacle rather than an ally for the party, despite his hatred for Strahd.

The party visited Argynvostholt in Sessions 22-23.

associations.name: Vladimir Horngaard
associations.relationship: Godfrey's commander at Argynvostholt. Godfrey disagrees with Vladimir's desire to let Strahd suffer eternally.

name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym
description: Sir Godfrey Gwilym is a revenant and former knight of the Order of the Silver Dragon at Argynvostholt. Unlike his commander Vladimir Horngaard, Godfrey retains his honor and desire to see Strahd destroyed. He is a noble spirit trapped in undeath, still dedicated to the order's original purpose of protecting the innocent.
dm_notes: Godfrey is willing to help the adventurers if they can find the skull of Argynvost, the silver dragon whose spirit still protects the mansion. His loyalty to the order's true purpose — defeating Strahd and ending the curse — puts him at odds with Vladimir. He is a potential ally despite his undead state.

associations.relationship: Davian and the Keepers of the Feather secretly work to undermine Strahd's control over Barovia.

associations.name: Urwin Martikov
associations.relationship: Davian's son. Runs the Blue Water Inn in Vallaki with his wife Danika.

associations.name: Adrian Martikov
associations.relationship: Davian's eldest son.

associations.relationship: Davian's adult daughter, married to Dag Martikov.

name: Davian Martikov
description: Davian Martikov is the patriarch of the Martikov family who runs the Wizard of Wines winery, which produces the only wine in Barovia — a vital commodity. Davian is gruff, practical, and deeply committed to the well-being of Barovia's people. He and his family have an unusually keen awareness of events throughout the land.
dm_notes:
Davian is the secret leader of the Keepers of the Feather, a network of wereravens who are vowed enemies of Strahd and operate as spies throughout Barovia. The Martikovs can shapeshift into ravens, allowing them to gather intelligence across the domain. Their wereraven nature is a closely guarded secret — even most of Barovia's residents don't know the truth about the Martikov family.

Davian's children include Urwin (who runs the Blue Water Inn in Vallaki with his wife Danika), Adrian (eldest son), and Stefania (married to Dag). The entire family are members of the Keepers of the Feather contingent in the Order of the Silver Dragon.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Pidlwick II wanders Castle Ravenloft, a relic of the court's past entertainment.

name: Pidlwick II
description: Pidlwick II is a small clockwork effigy that wanders Castle Ravenloft, performing odd routines and pantomimes. It appears harmless and even endearing — a curious relic of the castle's past. It may follow the party if they show it kindness.
dm_notes: Pidlwick II was built to resemble the original Pidlwick, a court jester beloved by Duchess Dorfniya. When a second fool was brought to court, the original Pidlwick grew jealous — and Pidlwick II murdered the original jester. The construct now wanders the castle performing its programmed routines, but is capable of 'accidentally' pushing creatures off ledges and other subtle violence. It is more dangerous than it appears.

associations.name: Emil Toranescu
associations.relationship: Emil replaced Kiril as Den Leader after the packs expelled him. Kiril views her as a weak usurper.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Kiril and his Blood Hunters serve Strahd without question.

associations.relationship: Kiril plotted with Elandra and Strahd's personal guard to ambush and kill Zuleika Toranescu, making it appear as if human hunters from Vallaki had done it.

associations.name: Zuleika Toranescu
associations.relationship: Kiril conspired to have Zuleika assassinated by Elandra Stormraven and Strahd's guard, disguised as human hunters. This allowed Kiril to seize control of the Den.

name: Kiril Stoyanovich
description: Kiril Stoyanovich is a brutal and hateful alpha werewolf who leads the Blood Hunters — a rogue pack of roughly 30 warriors who serve Lord Strahd without question. He was expelled from the Werewolf Den after the packs rose up against his savage leadership. Kiril is consumed by hatred toward the people of Vallaki, who killed his original pack when he was young.
dm_notes:
Kiril's original pack was wiped out by human hunters from Vallaki when he was young. The Toranescu pack took him in and raised him, but the hatred never left. When Zuleika Toranescu led the Den as a just and measured leader who sought peace with humans, Kiril saw it as weakness.

Knowing he could not defeat Zuleika in a direct challenge for leadership, Kiril plotted with Strahd and Elandra Stormraven to have Zuleika ambushed. Elandra and Strahd's personal guard killed Zuleika and his eldest son Ekrol while they were out hunting, dressed as human hunters from Vallaki to frame the humans and inflame the packs.

With Zuleika dead, Kiril seized control of the Den and all its packs. He ordered relentless attacks on human settlements — throwing werewolves against towns and farms without mercy. The resulting casualties were devastating on both sides, and eventually the Den rose up and expelled Kiril in favor of Emil Toranescu, Zuleika's mate, who was a respected warrior and shaman.

Enraged, Kiril left the Den with roughly 30 warriors who shared his hatred — mostly those who had lost loved ones to human hunters. They call themselves the Blood Hunters and roam Barovia in service to Strahd. It was the Blood Hunters who attacked the players outside the Tser Pool Vistani camp under orders from Elandra Stormraven, to test the party's capabilities.

The party fought through the Werewolf Den in Session 21.

associations.name: Zuleika Toranescu
associations.relationship: Emil's late mate. Zuleika was the former Den Leader who was assassinated by Elandra Stormraven and Strahd's guard.

associations.name: Kiril Stoyanovich
associations.relationship: Kiril was expelled from the Den and Emil replaced him as leader. Kiril views her as a weak usurper.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Emil fears Strahd but hopes the adventurers can defeat him and give the packs a chance at peace.

associations.name: Kiara Toranescu
associations.relationship: Emil's mother-in-law. Kiara serves as Den Mother and made a deal with the players on behalf of the Den.

associations.name: Duesius Toranescu
associations.relationship: Emil's father-in-law. Protective of the family and the Den.

associations.name: Jiro Toranescu
associations.relationship: Emil's young son. She would do anything to protect him.

associations.name: Elandra Stormraven
associations.relationship: Elandra was Strahd's emissary to the Den. She ordered Emil to attack the Wizard's Tower and kill the people there.

name: Emil Toranescu
description: Emil Toranescu is the current Den Leader of the Barovian werewolf packs — a respected warrior and shaman who took leadership after the packs expelled Kiril Stoyanovich. She does not want to continue the war with humans, having lost too many loved ones already, but feared to betray Strahd and his emissary Elandra Stormraven knowing it would mean death for her people and her young son Jiro.
dm_notes:
Emil is Zuleika's mate and took over as Den Leader after the packs expelled Kiril Stoyanovich. Like her husband's parents Kiara and Duesius, she does not want to continue the war with humans — they have lost too many loved ones and too much of their humanity.

When Elandra Stormraven came to the Den and ordered Emil to retrieve artifacts from the Wizard's Tower and kill the people there, Emil didn't want to do it but knew that resisting Strahd was certain death for all her people, including her small pup Jiro. She led the attack reluctantly.

The players believed Emil was killed when she jumped from the tower window to escape during the fight. Unknown to the players and the Den, she survived the fall. After the players left the Den the morning after the battle with Elandra Stormraven, Emil and about 8 other wounded from the Wizard's Tower battle returned. She learned of the deal that Kiara and Duesius made with the players and the defeat of all three Stormraven Sisters.

Emil plans to honor the agreement. She hopes the players will be able to defeat Strahd and give the packs a chance at peace. She is a pragmatic leader who will protect her people above all else.

associations.name: Emil Toranescu
associations.relationship: Zuleika's mate. Emil now leads the Den in his memory.

associations.name: Kiril Stoyanovich

associations.name: Elandra Stormraven

associations.name: Kiara Toranescu
associations.relationship: Zuleika's mother. She continues to serve the Den as Den Mother.

associations.name: Duesius Toranescu
associations.relationship: Zuleika's father.

associations.name: Ekrol Toranescu
associations.relationship: Zuleika's eldest son, who died alongside his father in the ambush.

associations.name: Jiro Toranescu
associations.relationship: Zuleika's youngest son, now in Emil's care.

name: Zuleika Toranescu
description: Zuleika Toranescu was the Pack Leader of the Toranescu pack and Den Leader — the leader of all the werewolf packs in Barovia. He was a capable warrior and a just leader who did not hate humans, as his mate Emil was once a human who was turned. He was assassinated by Elandra Stormraven and Strahd's personal guard, who disguised themselves as human hunters from Vallaki.
dm_notes:
Zuleika was a just leader who tried to reign in the elements within the Den that wanted to kill for the sake of killing. He did not hate humans — his mate Emil was once human before she was turned — and he believed in doing what was best for the Den and his Pack.

Kiril Stoyanovich, who Zuleika's family had taken in and raised after human hunters wiped out Kiril's pack, could not defeat Zuleika in a direct challenge for leadership. Instead, Kiril plotted with Strahd and Elandra Stormraven to have Zuleika ambushed. Elandra and Strahd's personal guard killed Zuleika and his eldest son Ekrol while they were out hunting, dressing as human hunters from Vallaki to frame the humans and inflame hatred within the packs.

Zuleika's death allowed Kiril to seize control of the Den, but his brutal leadership eventually led the packs to expel him in favor of Emil. Zuleika is remembered as the last good Den Leader, and his murder is one of Strahd's most cynical acts of manipulation.

associations.name: The Abbot
associations.relationship: The Abbot resides at the Abbey of Saint Markovia above Krezk. Baron Krezkov tolerates his presence.

name: Baron Krezkov
description: Baron Dmitri Krezkov is the burgomaster of Krezk, a walled village at the base of the Abbey of Saint Markovia. He is a cautious, protective leader who keeps Krezk's gates closed to outsiders. He grudgingly allows strangers in only if they can prove themselves useful to the village's survival.
dm_notes:
Krezkov's greatest sorrow is the recent death of his young son Ilya, which has left both him and his wife Anna devastated. This grief may make him susceptible to desperate bargains — particularly any offer that promises to restore his son.

The party visited Krezk in Sessions 22-23 while recovering the Amulet of Ravenkind from the Abbey.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: The Abbot is building a flesh golem bride for Strahd, believing this will end Barovia's curse.

associations.name: Baron Krezkov
associations.relationship: The Abbot resides in the Abbey above Krezk, which Baron Krezkov governs.

name: The Abbot
description: The Abbot is the enigmatic master of the Abbey of Saint Markovia above Krezk. He appears as a serene, handsome man who heals the sick and tends to the abbey's inhabitants — a collection of strange, misshapen creatures called mongrelfolk. The Abbot radiates an otherworldly calm and speaks of ending Barovia's curse with unsettling certainty.
dm_notes: The Abbot is a deva — an angelic being who descended to Barovia centuries ago to bring hope to its people. He restored the Abbey and healed the sick, but centuries of exposure to Barovia's corruption and the Dark Powers twisted his mind. He now creates grotesque mongrelfolk from body parts and is building a 'perfect bride' for Strahd — a flesh golem named Vasilka — believing this will end the curse. The Abbot's fall from grace is one of Barovia's greatest tragedies.

associations.name: Arrigal
associations.relationship: Arrigal is Luvash's brother. While Luvash focuses on family, Arrigal secretly serves Strahd as a spy.

associations.name: Madam Eva
associations.relationship: Madam Eva is the spiritual leader of the Vistani, including Luvash's encampment.

name: Luvash
description: Luvash is one of the leaders of the Vistani encampment outside Vallaki. He is a large, boisterous man consumed with worry over his missing daughter, Arabelle, who was kidnapped from the camp.
dm_notes: Luvash will reward anyone who brings his daughter Arabelle back safely. While the Vistani traditionally serve Strahd, Luvash's primary loyalty is to his family and his people. His grief and desperation make him a sympathetic figure and a useful quest-giver.

associations.name: Luvash
associations.relationship: Arrigal's brother. While Luvash is focused on family, Arrigal secretly serves Strahd.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Arrigal is one of Strahd's most trusted spies among the Vistani, reporting everything he learns.

name: Arrigal
description: Arrigal is Luvash's brother, a charming and clever Vistani who frequents the encampment outside Vallaki. He is quick with a smile, an offer of wine, and friendly conversation — always eager to learn about newcomers and their plans. Arrigal is deadly with a blade and carries himself with the easy confidence of someone who knows more than he lets on.
dm_notes: Arrigal is one of Strahd's most trusted spies among the Vistani. While appearing friendly and helpful to outsiders, he reports everything he learns directly to Strahd. He delivered the false letter from the Burgomaster that lured the adventurers to Barovia. His spy role is unknown to his brother Luvash, whose genuine concern for family Arrigal exploits as cover.

associations.name: Gertruda
associations.relationship: Gertruda is Mad Mary's daughter who left to find Castle Ravenloft, driving Mary to madness with grief.

associations.name: Oskander
associations.relationship: Mary's late husband. Oskander was one of the Skander duplicates of Yuri Skander. He was murdered by Rahadin.

associations.name: Yuri Skander
associations.relationship: Mary was Yuri's young apprentice before the amulet of wishing created the Skander duplicates. The incident traumatized her and changed her life forever.

name: Mad Mary Strazni
description: Mad Mary — born Mary Strazni — is a grief-stricken woman in the Village of Barovia whose daughter Gertruda went missing. She can be heard wailing from her boarded-up townhouse, inconsolable and half-mad with worry. Mary's screams echo through the empty streets, adding to the village's oppressive atmosphere.
dm_notes:
Mary Strazni was once a young and beautiful apprentice to the wizard Yuri Skander at Skanders Imporium of Magic in Vallaki. While studying an amulet of wishing — a pendant with a single copper coin enclosed in amber — she inadvertently triggered its power by expressing a wish for more men like Yuri in the world. The resulting flash created five duplicates of Yuri, each with all his memories and abilities. The incident shook Mary deeply.

One of the duplicates, Oskander, fell in love with Mary and married her. They had a daughter, Gertrude, whom they both loved dearly. When Rahadin murdered Oskander in a fit of rage, Mary was devastated. She eventually left Vallaki and returned to the Village of Barovia with Gertrude.

Years later, Gertrude left to find Castle Ravenloft, naively believing she could persuade Strahd to be kind. Mary doesn't know where Gertrude went — only that she is gone. The compounded losses of her husband and daughter have driven Mary to the edge of madness. The sound of her wailing is often the first thing the party hears when entering the Village of Barovia.

associations.name: Mad Mary
associations.relationship: Gertruda's grief-stricken mother, driven half-mad by her daughter's disappearance.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Gertruda naively came to Castle Ravenloft believing she could appeal to Strahd's better nature.

associations.name: Oskander
associations.relationship: Gertruda's father. Oskander was one of the Skander duplicates, murdered by Rahadin before Gertruda was old enough to remember him well.

name: Gertruda
description: Gertruda is Mad Mary's daughter, a sheltered young woman who vanished from the Village of Barovia. She has lived her entire life under her overprotective mother's care and is dangerously innocent about the true nature of the world outside her door.
dm_notes:
Gertruda is the daughter of Oskander and Mary Strazni (Mad Mary). Her father Oskander — one of the Skander duplicates of Yuri Skander — was murdered by Rahadin when Gertruda was young. After his death, Mary took Gertruda to the Village of Barovia where she grew up sheltered and overprotected.

Gertruda left the village to seek out Castle Ravenloft, believing she could appeal to Strahd's better nature. She now resides in the castle as Strahd's 'guest,' unaware of the mortal danger she is in. Her naivety is both tragic and dangerous — she genuinely believes Strahd is a misunderstood nobleman rather than a predatory vampire.

associations.name: Seraphine Stormraven
associations.relationship: Sibling. The Stormraven siblings served dark forces throughout the campaign.

associations.name: Elandra Stormraven
associations.relationship: Sibling. The Stormraven siblings served dark forces throughout the campaign.

name: Kaelin Stormraven
description: Kaelin Stormraven was a member of the Stormraven bloodline who wielded dark powers in service to malevolent forces. She was encountered by the party early in their journey, initially appearing as a lost girl before revealing her true nature.
dm_notes: The party defeated Kaelin during Sessions 3-4 on the 27th day of Tarsakh. She was encountered in a church setting along the Pelavir River. Her defeat was one of the party's first major victories and their first encounter with the Stormraven siblings.

associations.name: Kaelin Stormraven
associations.relationship: Sibling. The Stormraven siblings served dark forces throughout the campaign.

associations.name: Elandra Stormraven
associations.relationship: Sibling. The Stormraven siblings served dark forces throughout the campaign.

name: Seraphine Stormraven
description: Seraphine Stormraven was a powerful member of the Stormraven bloodline who wielded devastating magical abilities. She was the second Stormraven sibling encountered by the party.
dm_notes: Seraphine ambushed the party at Tser Pool. The Battle of Tser Pool during Sessions 15-16 on the 11th day of Kythorn was one of the campaign's most intense conflicts. Seraphine nearly overwhelmed the party before being defeated. Her death further weakened the Stormraven family's grip on the region.
