associations.relationship: Elandra allied with the werewolf pack led by Kiril at the Werewolf Den.

name: Elandra Stormraven
description: Elandra Stormraven was the third and most savage of the Stormraven siblings. She combined dark druidic magic with lycanthropic ferocity, making her one of the most dangerous foes the party faced.
dm_notes: Elandra had allied with the werewolf pack led by Kiril Stoyanovich and served as head of Strahd's Personal Guard. She was encountered at the Werewolf Den on the 18th day of Kythorn during Session 21. Her defeat eliminated the last of the active Stormraven threats.

associations.name: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin
associations.relationship: The Order of the Yellow Rose guards one of the Keys of Shorthagot and the planar gateway connected to the entity.

name: Mistress Clarissa Allyson
description: Mistress Clarissa Allyson is a senior member of the Order of the Yellow Rose, a monastic order based in Valls. She is a disciplined and knowledgeable monk who possesses deep understanding of the ancient threats facing Damara.
dm_notes: The Order of the Yellow Rose guards one of the Keys of Shorthagot and the planar gateway beneath their citadel in Valls. Mistress Allyson was rescued by the party during Sessions 6-7 when they arrived in Valls on the 30th day of Tarsakh. She possesses deep knowledge of the Shadowfell gateways and the ancient threat of Shorthagot. She serves as a key information source about the campaign's overarching cosmic conflict.

associations.name: Rudolph Van Richten
associations.relationship: Rudolph d'Avernir is an alias used by Van Richten at the Wizard Tower.

name: Rudolph d'Avernir
description: Rudolph d'Avernir is a knowledgeable scholar of the arcane and the planes who resides in a Wizard Tower in Barovia. His tower contains a library of rare texts and magical artifacts.
dm_notes:
The party encountered Rudolph d'Avernir at the Wizard Tower during Session 20 on the 17th day of Kythorn. He provided crucial information about the magical forces at work in Barovia and the broader conflict involving Shorthagot and the Shadowfell.

Rudolph d'Avernir is an alias used by Rudolph Van Richten. His true identity as the legendary monster hunter is concealed behind the persona of an eccentric scholar.

associations.name: Prince Ian Frostmantle
associations.relationship: Prince Ian is the heir to the Frostmantle dynasty that Lord Geoffrey governs.

associations.name: Bragus Orentide
associations.relationship: Bragus serves as a guard captain and military advisor in service to the Frostmantle dynasty.

name: Lord Geoffrey Frostmantle
description: Lord Geoffrey Frostmantle is a nobleman of the Frostmantle dynasty that has ruled Damara since the great reunification in 1285 DR. He is a capable warrior and diplomat who oversees the defense of Damara's borders.
dm_notes: The Frostmantles are considered fair and just rulers who restored order after centuries of conflict. Lord Geoffrey maintains the ancient alliance with the Order of the Yellow Rose and takes the threat of the Shadowfell gateways seriously. He commands the loyalty of soldiers like Bragus Orentide and oversees the kingdom's military defense.

associations.name: Lord Geoffrey Frostmantle
associations.relationship: Prince Ian is the heir to Lord Geoffrey's Frostmantle dynasty.

name: Prince Ian Frostmantle
description: Prince Ian Frostmantle is the heir to the Frostmantle dynasty of Damara. A young paladin trained in the martial and divine traditions, he represents the next generation of Damaran leadership.
dm_notes: Prince Ian is deeply concerned about the supernatural threats emanating from Barovia and the Shadowfell gateways. He has been instrumental in rallying support for the party's mission and maintains close ties with the Order of the Yellow Rose. He was aboard the Sea Spray and was wounded during the Night Screamer attack in Session 02. The crew took him and his uncle to White Bridge for safety.

associations.name: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin
associations.relationship: Lady Williams' machinations served to breach the Shadowfell gateway, furthering Shorthagot's influence.

name: Lady Elysra Nivariel Williams
description: Lady Elysra Nivariel Williams is a noblewoman of Valls who married Lord Edmund Williams. By 1496 DR, she was at the center of the catastrophic events known as the Fall of Valls. She is beautiful, charming, and politically astute — a masterful manipulator who uses intrigue to achieve her goals.
dm_notes: Lady Williams is a succubus who infiltrated Damaran society through her marriage to Lord Edmund Williams. She orchestrated the Fall of Valls, breaching the Shadowfell gateway beneath the Order of the Yellow Rose's citadel. Her machinations unleashed dark forces that threatened all of Damara. Her true demonic nature is revealed only in her transformed state — in human guise she is indistinguishable from a mortal noblewoman.

associations.name: Tharizdun, The Chained God
associations.relationship: Shorthagot is an ancient avatar and harbinger of Tharizdun, working to free the Chained God.

associations.name: Lady Elysra Nivariel Williams
associations.relationship: Lady Williams orchestrated the Fall of Valls, breaching a Shadowfell gateway connected to Shorthagot's prison.

name: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin
description: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin, is an ancient entity imprisoned in the Shadowfell. Its influence seeps through the weakened barriers between planes, corrupting everything it touches. It is the ultimate threat behind many of the campaign's events.
dm_notes:
Shorthagot is an ancient avatar of Tharizdun, the Chained God — one of the most terrifying entities in all existence. The Netherese Empire accidentally contacted Shorthagot through their Great Machine at Thul Avenar, and the entity was eventually imprisoned in the Shadowfell after the Time of Troubles. Its binding was split into four Keys scattered across Damara.

Lady Williams orchestrated the Fall of Valls to breach a Shadowfell gateway connected to Shorthagot's prison. The Order of the Yellow Rose guards one of the Keys.

name: Father Alric
description: Father Alric is a priest who has accompanied the party during their journey. A man of deep faith, he provides spiritual guidance and healing magic to those in need.
dm_notes: Father Alric's dedication to combating the undead and fiendish forces of Barovia makes him a steadfast ally in the fight against Strahd and the greater darkness threatening the region. His healing abilities have proven invaluable during the party's travels.

associations.name: Ezmerelda d'Avenir
associations.relationship: Velinka is connected to the d'Avenir family of monster hunters.

name: Velinka d'Avenir
description: Velinka d'Avenir is a Vistani woman who serves as a guide and source of information about the Vistani people. Resourceful and street-smart, she walks a careful line between the Vistani traditions and her own moral compass.
dm_notes: Velinka is connected to the d'Avenir family of monster hunters. Her Vistani heritage and knowledge of the complex relationship between the Vistani and Strahd make her a valuable source of information for those navigating Barovia.

associations.name: Lord Geoffrey Frostmantle
associations.relationship: Bragus serves as a guard captain and military advisor in service to the Frostmantle dynasty.

name: Bragus Orentide
description: Bragus Orentide is a seasoned warrior and guard captain in the service of the Frostmantle dynasty. He is known for his unwavering loyalty and tactical acumen.
dm_notes: A veteran of numerous conflicts, Bragus serves as a protector and military advisor, often found at the front lines whenever Damara faces threats from the encroaching darkness of the Shadowfell.

associations.name: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin
associations.relationship: Edic's research into the Netheril Empire's Great Machine and the Keys of Shorthagot is central to understanding the cosmic threat.

name: Edic Tholomen
description: Edic Tholomen is a scholar and wizard who studies the ancient Netherese ruins and the magical forces that permeate the region around Damara. Edic is soft-spoken but brilliant, often lost in thought about arcane theories.
dm_notes: His research into the Netheril Empire's Great Machine and the Keys of Shorthagot has provided crucial intelligence about the nature of the cosmic threat facing the world.

associations.name: Gorak Broken Tusk
associations.relationship: Fellow Sea Spray crew member. Garrick joined not long after Gorak and the two became close through their shared loyalty to the crew.

associations.name: Selene Brightwater
associations.relationship: Fellow Sea Spray crew member. Part of the tight-knit family Garrick found aboard the ship.

name: Garrick Ironbrow
location: Pelavir River, past Bloodstone Pass (Sea Spray wreckage)
description: Garrick Ironbrow is a dwarven fighter and the shipwright of the Sea Spray. Stoic and immensely strong, Garrick originally boarded the ship years ago as a hired guard for a single voyage. He found himself unexpectedly drawn to the strange company of a Tabaxi captain and her orc first mate — their camaraderie was unlike anything he had known. He signed on permanently not long after Gorak joined, and has been part of the crew ever since. Garrick keeps the Sea Spray seaworthy and swings a hammer with equal skill whether he's driving nails or cracking skulls.
dm_notes:
Garrick has a tragic backstory involving pirates and revenge that drove him from his former life as a blacksmith to the sea. He doesn't talk about it, and the crew knows better than to ask. What matters to Garrick is the present — the ship, the crew, and the work.

He joined the Sea Spray not long after Gorak, initially hired as a guard for a single voyage. The unlikely friendship between a Tabaxi swashbuckler, a full-blooded orc, and a dwarven blacksmith was something Garrick never expected, but it became the closest thing to family he'd had since losing his old life. He stayed aboard and took on the role of shipwright, keeping the vessel in fighting shape.

The Sea Spray set out from Frosthaven in Vasa, carrying the party as hired protection due to rumors of fighting along the Pelavir River — King Frostmantle's wars with Narfell had made the route dangerous. During Session 02, the Night Screamer attacked. Garrick survived the fight and helped rescue Prince Ian Frostmantle from the wreckage. While the party left to find Mistress Clarissa Allyson, Garrick returned to White Bridge with the Captain and First Officer, escorting the wounded Prince and his uncle to safety from the growing reach of the Mist.

associations.name: Selene Brightwater
associations.relationship: Fellow Sea Spray crew member. Gorak sees Selene and the rest of the crew as the family he never had.

associations.name: Garrick Ironbrow
associations.relationship: Fellow Sea Spray crew member and shipwright. Part of the family Gorak found aboard the Sea Spray.

name: Gorak Broken Tusk
location: Pelavir River, past Bloodstone Pass (Sea Spray wreckage)
description: Gorak Broken Tusk is the First Mate of the Sea Spray and a towering mountain of muscle wrapped in a Blue Seaman's coat that would never button. A full-blooded orc with piercing yellow eyes and countless battle scars, Gorak wields a ship's anchor as his weapon of choice. He is disciplined despite his fearsome appearance, commanding respect through strength and unwavering loyalty. Captain Reaven was the only captain who would give him a chance and let him serve aboard her ship — a debt of trust that Gorak repays with absolute devotion. The crew of the Sea Spray became the family he never had.
dm_notes:
The Sea Spray set out from Frosthaven in Vasa, carrying the party as hired protection — King Frostmantle's wars with Narfell had made the Pelavir River route dangerous. Gorak survived the Night Screamer attack during Session 02 but took a huge bloody gash in the fight, swinging his anchor with deadly force against the creatures. After the Sea Spray was wrecked on the shore of the Pelavir River just past Bloodstone Pass, Gorak stayed behind with Captain Reaven to tend to the wounded Prince Ian Frostmantle and salvage what they could from the wreck. The party left to find Mistress Clarissa Allyson, while Gorak and the crew escorted the Prince and his uncle to White Bridge and safety from the growing reach of the Mist.

Gorak's loyalty to Emerald Eyes is absolute — she gave him something no one else would: a chance. As an orc, he was turned away from every crew and company he approached. Reaven judged him by his strength and character, not his race, and that earned her his undying loyalty. Over time, the crew — Reaven, Selene, Garrick — became the only family he has ever known.

name: Haldor Stonehand
description: Haldor Stonehand is a dwarven cleric and craftsman who combines divine magic with exceptional skill in stonework and metalcraft. His stone hand, the result of a petrification curse he only partially reversed, has become his namesake.
dm_notes: He serves as a spiritual leader among the dwarven communities of Damara and has dedicated his life to creating holy artifacts capable of combating the undead plague spreading from Barovia.

name: Mira Fleetfoot
description: Mira Fleetfoot is a halfling scout who specializes in navigating the dangerous borderlands between Damara and Barovia. Quick-witted and light on her feet, Mira has an uncanny ability to slip past danger unseen.
dm_notes: She serves as a courier and intelligence gatherer for the forces opposing Strahd, carrying messages between allied groups scattered throughout the region.

associations.name: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin
associations.relationship: Olaera's expertise in planar magic is invaluable in understanding the weakening boundaries that allow Shorthagot's influence to spread.

name: Olaera Moonsilver
description: Olaera Moonsilver is an elven enchantress who has studied the mystical barriers between the Material Plane and the Shadowfell for centuries. Olaera is graceful, ancient, and carries the weight of seeing civilizations rise and fall.
dm_notes: Her expertise in planar magic makes her invaluable in understanding the Mists of Ravenloft and the weakening boundaries that allow Shorthagot's influence to spread.

associations.name: Lord Geoffrey Frostmantle
associations.relationship: Rurik serves as a soldier in the Frostmantle dynasty's forces.

name: Rurik
description: Rurik is a stalwart soldier in service to the Frostmantle dynasty. A man of few words but decisive action, he is respected by his fellow soldiers for his bravery and reliability.
dm_notes: Rurik has proven himself in numerous engagements against the dark forces threatening Damara. He is always the first to volunteer for dangerous missions.

associations.name: Gorak Broken Tusk
associations.relationship: Gorak is fiercely protective of Selene, treating her like a younger sister. He was one of the first crew members to accept her after Captain Reaven took her in.

associations.name: Garrick Ironbrow
associations.relationship: Garrick watches over Selene with gruff, paternal concern. He carved her first wand handle and pretends not to worry when her wild magic surges.

name: Selene Brightwater
location: Pelavir River, past Bloodstone Pass (Sea Spray wreckage)
description: Selene Brightwater is the youngest member of the Sea Spray's crew — a young half-elf who looks more human than elf, with dark hair, pale skin, and striking violet eyes. Selene ran away from a cruel family that had taken her in as little more than a servant. She discovered her wild magic as a child, and the uncontrollable surges only made her captors treat her worse. When she fled, she stowed away aboard the Sea Spray. Captain Reaven was furious when she found the girl — but the more she listened to Selene's story, the softer she became. The crew adopted Selene as their own, and she has been fiercely protected by them ever since.
dm_notes:
Selene is emotionally volatile, which mirrors her wild magic — her spells surge unpredictably when she is frightened or upset. She is deeply loyal to Captain Reaven and sees the crew as the only real family she has ever known. Gorak, Garrick, and Reaven are all fiercely protective of their young ward, and anyone who threatens Selene will answer to the entire crew.

Selene is quiet and reserved around strangers but opens up quickly once she feels safe. She has a habit of tucking her hands into the sleeves of her cloak when nervous. Despite her youth and her difficult past, she is brave — she just doesn't always know it yet.

The Sea Spray set out from Frosthaven in Vasa with the party aboard as hired protection — the Pelavir River was dangerous due to King Frostmantle's wars with Narfell. Selene survived the Night Screamer attack during Session 02 and stayed behind with the rest of the crew at the wreckage on the shore of the Pelavir River. While the party left to find Mistress Clarissa Allyson, the crew escorted the wounded Prince Frostmantle and his uncle to White Bridge and safety from the growing reach of the Mist.

name: Ser Brennor Cale
description: Ser Brennor Cale is a paladin and knight sworn to protect Damara. A man of unwavering faith and courage, he wears gleaming plate armor bearing the crest of his order and wields a blessed longsword.
dm_notes: Brennor has dedicated his life to the eradication of evil and the defense of Damara from the supernatural threats emerging from the Shadowfell. He is among the foremost champions standing against the advance of darkness.

name: Thalin Emberbrew
description: Thalin Emberbrew is a dwarven ranger and master brewer who knows the mountains and forests of Damara like no other. His 'Emberbrew' — a dwarf-strength spirit — is legendary.
dm_notes: Thalin serves as a guide through the treacherous wilderness. His fiery concoctions are as potent in combat as they are at the tavern table. Rumor has it, his Emberbrew can burn through a troll's regeneration.

name: Vera Thorn
description: Vera Thorn is a mysterious herbalist and hedge witch who lives on the borderlands between Damara and the Mists. She possesses knowledge of rare plants and potions. Her thorny temperament matches her namesake.
dm_notes: Some of Vera's potions can protect against the effects of Barovia's curse. Her patron and true allegiances are unclear — she helps those who seek her out but always at a price.

associations.name: Milivoj
associations.relationship: Henrik manipulated Milivoj into stealing the bones of Saint Andral from the church.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Henrik was coerced by Strahd's agents into hiding vampire spawn in his shop.

name: Henrik Van der Voort
description: Henrik Van der Voort is the coffin maker of Vallaki, a nervous, frightened man who lives and works alone in his shop. He is perpetually anxious, avoids eye contact, and clearly hides some terrible secret. Henrik is terrified of something but too afraid to seek help.
dm_notes: Henrik has been coerced by Strahd's agents into hiding vampire spawn in the upstairs of his shop. He lives in constant terror, knowing that the creatures above could descend and kill him at any moment, but is too afraid of Strahd's retribution to seek help. He manipulated the gravedigger Milivoj into stealing the bones of Saint Andral from the church, removing the holy protection that kept vampires out. His shop has become an unwitting den of undeath in the heart of Vallaki.

associations.name: Henrik Van der Voort
associations.relationship: Milivoj was manipulated by Henrik into stealing the sacred bones of Saint Andral.

name: Milivoj
description: Milivoj is a young gravedigger at the Church of St. Andral in Vallaki. He is scrawny, overworked, and perpetually dirty from digging graves. Milivoj struggles to feed his younger siblings and is desperate enough to take on any work that pays.
dm_notes: Desperate to feed his siblings, Milivoj was manipulated by Henrik Van der Voort into stealing the sacred bones of Saint Andral from the church — the relic that protected the building from vampire entry. He is guilt-ridden but terrified of the consequences of his actions. The theft of the bones is a key plot point in the Feast of St. Andral event.

associations.name: Shorthagot, Harbinger of Ruin
associations.relationship: Shorthagot serves as Tharizdun's avatar and harbinger, working to free the Chained God from imprisonment.

name: Tharizdun, The Chained God
description: Tharizdun is the Chained God, an ancient deity of madness, entropy, and eternal darkness who was imprisoned by the combined efforts of all other gods at the dawn of time. His very existence threatens the fabric of reality. Even imprisoned, his influence corrupts and drives mortals to madness.
dm_notes: Shorthagot serves as Tharizdun's avatar and harbinger, working to free the Chained God from his cosmic imprisonment. The four Keys of Shorthagot scattered across Damara are connected to the bindings that keep this terrible entity sealed away. The campaign's ultimate stakes involve preventing Tharizdun's release through the Shadowfell gateways.

associations.name: Ireena Kolyana
associations.relationship: Kolyan's adopted daughter. He found her as a young child wandering the Svalich Woods after a dire wolf attack separated her from her biological family. He raised her as his own alongside Ismark.

associations.name: Ismark Kolyanovich
associations.relationship: Kolyan's biological son. Ismark inherited the burden of Burgomaster after Kolyan's death and carries the weight of protecting his sister.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Kolyan wrote a desperate letter pleading for help against Strahd's attacks on his home. Strahd's repeated visits to claim Ireena drove Kolyan to his death from sheer terror and exhaustion.

associations.name: Father Donavich
associations.relationship: The village priest who presided over Kolyan's funeral at the church in the Village of Barovia.

name: Kolyan Indirovich
description: Kolyan Indirovich was the Burgomaster of the Village of Barovia and the father of Ismark and adoptive father of Ireena. A good and honorable man, Kolyan spent his final days barricading his home against Strahd's nightly assaults as the vampire lord came to claim Ireena. The relentless siege broke Kolyan's health and spirit, and he died of a heart attack brought on by fright. His death left his children to face Strahd's wrath alone and set the campaign's events in motion.
dm_notes:
Kolyan's name follows the Barovian patronymic tradition — 'Indirovich' means 'son of Indir,' his father. His children carry his name forward: Ismark Kolyanovich ('son of Kolyan') and Ireena Kolyana ('daughter of Kolyan'). There is no family surname.

Kolyan found the young Ireena wandering at the edge of the Svalich Woods as a small child after a dire wolf attack scattered her biological family. He took her in and raised her as his own daughter alongside Ismark, never telling her the truth of her origins. Her biological brother Izek was separated during the same attack and eventually ended up in Vallaki, taken in by the Vallakovich household.

Kolyan was close friends with Baron Vargas Vallakovich and the other burgomasters of Barovia. The two families visited each other regularly, and Kolyan's children attended the Festival of Light in Vallaki as honoured guests. This close bond is why Ismark was certain Ireena would find safety with the Vallakoviches.

Kolyan was a descendant of Ismark the Great, a legendary Barovian hero, which is why the villagers mockingly call his son 'Ismark the Lesser.' Despite the impossible situation, Kolyan refused to surrender Ireena to Strahd. The forged letter bearing his name — the one that lured the adventurers to Barovia — was actually written by Strahd to draw fresh prey into his domain.

At campaign start, Kolyan's body lies in the family home awaiting burial. Ismark asks the party to help escort the coffin to the church for a proper funeral with Father Donavich.

associations.name: Parriwimple
associations.relationship: Bildrath's nephew and enforcer at the shop. Dimwitted but massively strong, Parriwimple does the heavy lifting and intimidates anyone who might cause trouble.

name: Bildrath Cantemir
description: Bildrath Cantemir is the owner of the only general store in the Village of Barovia. He is a greedy, self-serving man who gouges prices mercilessly — charging ten times the normal rate for basic supplies because he knows his customers have no alternative. Bildrath views the misery of Barovia as a business opportunity and shows no sympathy for those who cannot afford his prices. His massive nephew Parriwimple serves as both stock boy and enforcer.
dm_notes: Bildrath is universally disliked but tolerated because his shop is the only source of equipment and supplies in the village. He refuses to negotiate and will call Parriwimple to deal with anyone who tries to steal or threaten him. Despite his greed, he is a coward who will capitulate if genuinely threatened with violence. He has no loyalty to Strahd or anyone else — only to his own profit.

associations.name: Bildrath Cantemir
associations.relationship: Parriwimple's uncle and employer. Bildrath uses Parriwimple's strength to run the shop and intimidate customers.

name: Parriwimple
description: Parriwimple is Bildrath Cantemir's nephew — a hulking, simple-minded young man of immense physical strength. He works at his uncle's general store hauling crates, stocking shelves, and serving as an unspoken threat to anyone who might cause trouble. Despite his intimidating size, Parriwimple is gentle and childlike in demeanor. He genuinely wants to help people and is easily befriended with kind words or small gifts.
dm_notes: Parriwimple is far stronger than he looks — easily capable of overpowering most adventurers in a grapple. However, he has no desire to fight and will only become violent if his uncle is directly threatened. He is easily manipulated by anyone who shows him kindness, which Bildrath exploits constantly. If befriended, Parriwimple can be a useful source of simple, honest information about the village — he says what he sees without guile or filter.

associations.name: Luna E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Sarkov's wife. Luna speaks for them both since Sarkov lost his tongue. They gave up the Vistani traveling life together when they married.

associations.name: Magda E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Sarkov's widowed aunt who handles cooking at the inn. Fiercely protective of her nephew.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Strahd had Sarkov's tongue cut out for speaking against the vampire lord's will. This act of cruelty drove Sarkov and Luna to abandon their Vistani caravan.

name: Sarkov E'Tressa
location: Village of Barovia (Blood of the Vine Inn)
description: Sarkov E'Tressa is the co-owner of the Blood of the Vine Inn in the Village of Barovia. A broad-shouldered, silent man in his late 40s, Sarkov communicates entirely through gestures and steady presence — his tongue was cut out for speaking against Strahd. Originally from the Tser Hill Vistani, Sarkov and his wife Luna gave up the Travel when they married and settled in the village as innkeepers, their views no longer aligned with the caravan's deference to Strahd.
dm_notes:
Sarkov is watchful and protective. He runs the inn's bar with quiet efficiency, and regulars understand his gestures and expressions well enough to communicate. He harbors a deep, silent hatred for Strahd but is pragmatic enough to know that open defiance means death. The party first met Sarkov on arrival in the Village of Barovia — Gregor awkwardly discovered his missing tongue while trying to converse with him.

The E'Tressa family are originally from the Tser Hill Vistani but gave up the nomadic life when Sarkov married Luna, who was from the Village of Barovia. Their decision to settle down and abandon the Travel put them at odds with their caravan, and they now live in exile from their former community.

associations.name: Sarkov E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Luna's husband. She speaks for them both since Sarkov cannot. They gave up the Vistani traveling life when they married.

associations.name: Ilyana Kostova
associations.relationship: Luna's godmother, who followed the family into exile at the inn.

associations.name: Klara Vorovich
associations.relationship: Luna's distant cousin and the inn's bookkeeper. Unknown to Luna, Klara secretly spies for Strahd.

name: Luna E'Tressa
location: Village of Barovia (Blood of the Vine Inn)
description: Luna E'Tressa is the co-owner of the Blood of the Vine Inn and the voice of the establishment. A striking woman in her early 40s with kind but weary eyes, Luna was born in the Village of Barovia and married Sarkov of the Tser Hill Vistani. When Sarkov's tongue was cut out by Strahd's order, the couple abandoned the Travel and settled in her home village to run the inn. Luna was once a singer among the Vistani, and her warm voice still carries the cadence of old caravan songs. She speaks for both herself and Sarkov, translating his gestures for newcomers.
dm_notes:
Luna is the heart of the Blood of the Vine. She manages the inn's guests, mediates disputes, and keeps the extended family functioning. She is warm but exhausted by the weight of their exile and the constant oppression of life in Barovia. She knows more about the village's secrets than she lets on — years of running the only inn in town means she hears everything.

Her marriage to Sarkov was a love match that cost them both their Vistani community. The Tser Hill Vistani viewed their departure as a betrayal, and the couple has had no contact with their former caravan since settling in the village.

associations.name: Sarkov E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Magda's nephew. She followed him into exile and fiercely protects him and Luna.

name: Magda E'Tressa
location: Village of Barovia (Blood of the Vine Inn)
description: Magda E'Tressa is Sarkov's widowed aunt and the cook at the Blood of the Vine Inn. A stout woman in her late 60s with a hooked nose and a cane she doesn't truly need, Magda is gruff, practical, and scolds patrons like unruly children. She followed her nephew into exile from the Tser Hill Vistani and has appointed herself the family's fierce protector. Her cooking is simple Barovian fare — heavy stews, black bread, and whatever root vegetables survive the cursed soil — but it keeps the inn running.
dm_notes: Magda uses her cane more as a prop and occasional weapon than a walking aid. She is sharper than she appears and has a keen sense for trouble. She will fiercely defend Sarkov and Luna from anyone she perceives as a threat. Magda left the Tser Hill Vistani without hesitation when Sarkov was mutilated — family loyalty runs deeper than any caravan bond for her.

associations.name: Luna E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Ilyana is Luna's godmother. She dotes on Luna and followed the family into exile.

name: Ilyana Kostova
location: Village of Barovia (Blood of the Vine Inn)
description: Ilyana Kostova is Luna E'Tressa's godmother and a longtime fixture at the Blood of the Vine Inn. A tall, wiry woman in her early 70s who drapes herself in bright scarves, Ilyana was once a singer and dancer among the Tser Hill Vistani. Her voice has gone raspy with age, but she still hums old caravan tunes while she cleans. She claims to have 'second sight' — the ability to sense the presence of evil and read omens in ordinary events. Most dismiss it as superstition, though her warnings have an unsettling habit of proving accurate.
dm_notes: Ilyana's 'second sight' is left deliberately ambiguous — she may genuinely have a minor gift of divination, or she may simply be a perceptive old woman who reads people well. Either way, she provides atmospheric flavor and can serve as a cryptic information source. She knows the old Vistani stories and traditions, and her warnings about roads, weather, and strangers carry weight with the inn's regulars even if they roll their eyes.

associations.name: Luna E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Klara is Luna's distant cousin. Luna trusts her completely, unaware of her treachery.

associations.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
associations.relationship: Klara secretly passes information about inn patrons to Vistani loyalists who report directly to Strahd.

associations.name: Arrigal
associations.relationship: Klara passes her intelligence through Vistani loyalist channels that ultimately reach Arrigal and Strahd's spy network.

name: Klara Vorovich
location: Village of Barovia (Blood of the Vine Inn)
description: Klara Vorovich is Luna E'Tressa's distant cousin and the bookkeeper at the Blood of the Vine Inn. A thin, severe woman in her late 60s with long gray hair always tied back in a tight bun, Klara serves drinks with a forced smile and keeps the inn's ledgers in meticulous order. She is quiet, efficient, and always seems to be listening.
dm_notes:
Klara is a spy for Strahd — she carefully observes every traveler who passes through the inn and passes her intelligence to Vistani loyalists who report to Strahd's network. She never fully abandoned her loyalty to the Vistani's traditional service to Strahd. While the rest of the E'Tressa family broke with the caravan, Klara followed them to the village as an embedded informant.

Klara is the reason Strahd always seems to know when strangers arrive in the Village of Barovia. She is calculating, patient, and careful — she has maintained her cover for years without arousing suspicion from her own family. If exposed, she will attempt to flee to the Vistani camps rather than fight.

This is a potential plot twist for the party — discovering that even the 'safe haven' of the Blood of the Vine has Strahd's eyes and ears inside it.

associations.name: Sarkov E'Tressa
associations.relationship: Luvash works at the Blood of the Vine Inn alongside the E'Tressa family.

associations.name: Morgantha
associations.relationship: Morgantha and her coven kidnapped Luvash's young daughter from the Village of Barovia. This loss drove Luvash to seek help from the adventurers.

name: Luvash
description: Luvash is a Vistani man who works at the Blood of the Vine Inn as a handyman and horse handler. A wiry man with a neatly trimmed beard and once-laughing eyes now dulled by grief, Luvash came to the village with his wife and young daughter seeking a quieter life away from the caravans. His world was shattered when his daughter was taken by the hags of Old Bonegrinder — lured away under the guise of the old women who sell dream pastries in the village. Luvash was the first NPC the party encountered in distress, and his desperate plea for help led them toward the Bonegrinder windmill.
dm_notes: Luvash will reward anyone who brings his daughter Arabelle back safely. While the Vistani traditionally serve Strahd, Luvash's primary loyalty is to his family and his people. His grief and desperation make him a sympathetic figure and a useful quest-giver.

associations.name: Morgantha Wormwiggle
associations.relationship: Bella's mother and the matriarch of the Bonegrinder coven. Morgantha leads the coven and handles the sale of dream pastries.

associations.name: Offalia Wormwiggle
associations.relationship: Bella's daughter and the youngest member of the coven. Offalia is the most openly cruel of the three.

name: Bella Wormwiggle
description: Bella Wormwiggle appears as a hunched, middle-aged woman with stringy hair and a gap-toothed smile. She can be found at the Old Bonegrinder windmill alongside her mother and daughter, tending to the 'baking.' Bella is quieter than her mother Morgantha but watches visitors with unsettling intensity.
dm_notes:
Bella is a night hag and the middle generation of the Bonegrinder coven. She handles the grim work of processing the stolen children's life force into the dream pastry dough. Bella is pragmatic and methodical where Morgantha is cunning and Offalia is sadistic — she views the harvesting of children as simply the family trade.

In her true hag form, Bella is gaunt and terrible, with clawed hands stained dark from her work. She is the most dangerous of the three in direct combat, favoring her claws and the coven's shared spellcasting. The party encountered the coven at Old Bonegrinder during Sessions 17-18.

associations.name: Morgantha Wormwiggle
associations.relationship: Offalia's grandmother and the matriarch of the Bonegrinder coven.

associations.name: Bella Wormwiggle
associations.relationship: Offalia's mother and fellow coven member. Bella does most of the pastry preparation while Offalia handles the children.

name: Offalia Wormwiggle
description: Offalia Wormwiggle appears as a young gril around the age of 10-12 years with a nervous giggle and fidgeting hands. She often goes with her grandmother to sell pies and charms the locals with her smile..
dm_notes:
Offalia is a night hag and the youngest member of the Bonegrinder coven — Morgantha's granddaughter and Bella's daughter. She is the most openly sadistic of the three, taking particular delight in tormenting the kidnapped children before they are ground into dream pastry ingredients. Offalia keeps the children caged on the upper floor of the windmill and 'plays' with them in ways that would horrify even hardened adventurers.

Despite her cruelty, Offalia is the weakest link in the coven — she is the most likely to panic if the coven is attacked and may try to flee rather than fight if separated from her mother and grandmother. She is the one who interacts with the other children the most, and is the one that slips the a treat to help her Grandmother or Mother take them.

associations.name: Iskander
associations.relationship: Duplicate of Yuri. Helps run Skanders Imporium of Magic.

associations.name: Eskander
associations.relationship: Duplicate of Yuri. Helps run Skanders Imporium of Magic.

associations.name: Oskander
associations.relationship: Duplicate of Yuri. Married Mary Strazni and was murdered by Rahadin.

associations.name: Askander
associations.relationship: Duplicate of Yuri. Runs the Alchemy shop in Vallaki.

associations.name: Uskander
associations.relationship: Duplicate of Yuri. Runs the Antique store in Vallaki.

associations.name: Mad Mary Strazni
associations.relationship: Mary was Yuri's young apprentice. She accidentally triggered the amulet of wishing that created the Skander duplicates.

name: Yuri Skander
description: Yuri Skander is a respected wizard who runs Skanders Imporium of Magic in Vallaki, buying and selling much of the magical merchandise that the Tser Hill Vistani bring into town from beyond the Mists. He is the 'Prime' Skander — the original — from whom five duplicates were created by a magical accident involving an amulet of wishing.
dm_notes:
Yuri was a respected wizard whose young apprentice Mary Strazni accidentally triggered an amulet of wishing — a pendant with a single copper coin enclosed in amber. While studying it, Mary expressed a wish that there were more men like Yuri in Vallaki. The resulting flash created five duplicates of Yuri, each with all his memories and abilities. They decided Yuri should remain the Prime Skander, and the duplicates took new names: Iskander, Askander, Uskander, Eskander, and Oskander. Over the years, each became their own person with distinct interests and lives.

Yuri, Iskander, and Eskander continue to run the Imporium together. When Rahadin murdered Oskander, the Skanders vowed never to forgive Strahd. The entire Skander family now harbors a deep hatred for the vampire lord and his servants.

associations.name: Yuri Skander
associations.relationship: The Prime Skander, from whom Iskander was duplicated.

name: Iskander
description: Iskander is one of the five duplicates of Yuri Skander, created by the accidental triggering of an amulet of wishing. He continues to work alongside Yuri and Eskander at Skanders Imporium of Magic in Vallaki.
dm_notes: Iskander retains all of Yuri's original memories and magical abilities but has developed into his own person over the years. He helps run the Imporium and shares the other Skanders' hatred of Strahd after Rahadin murdered their brother Oskander.

associations.name: Yuri Skander
associations.relationship: The Prime Skander, from whom Askander was duplicated.

name: Askander
description: Askander is one of the five duplicates of Yuri Skander who took up alchemy after the duplication. He owns and operates the Alchemy shop in Vallaki and has become very skilled at his craft.
dm_notes: Askander diverged from the other Skanders by pursuing alchemy rather than general wizardry. He is very good at it at this point and his shop is a valuable resource in Vallaki. He shares the Skanders' hatred of Strahd after Rahadin murdered their brother Oskander.

associations.name: Yuri Skander
associations.relationship: The Prime Skander, from whom Uskander was duplicated.

name: Uskander
description: Uskander is one of the five duplicates of Yuri Skander who developed a love for all things ancient. He runs the Antique store in Vallaki and is a knowledgeable scholar of Barovian history and artifacts.
dm_notes:
Uskander became close friends with Nikolai Wachter, bonding over their shared love of history and antiquities. However, when it was learned that Nikolai was associating with Strahd — the master of Rahadin, who killed Oskander — Uskander broke off the friendship. This happened shortly before Nikolai was murdered while traveling to investigate ruins to the south near Mount Ghakis.

Uskander now runs the Antique store in Vallaki and shares the Skanders' hatred of Strahd. His knowledge of ancient artifacts and Barovian history makes him a potentially valuable resource for the party.

associations.name: Yuri Skander
associations.relationship: The Prime Skander, from whom Eskander was duplicated.

name: Eskander
description: Eskander is one of the five duplicates of Yuri Skander. He continues to work alongside Yuri and Iskander at Skanders Imporium of Magic in Vallaki.
dm_notes: Eskander retains all of Yuri's original memories and magical abilities but has developed into his own person over the years. He helps run the Imporium and shares the other Skanders' hatred of Strahd after Rahadin murdered their brother Oskander.

associations.name: Yuri Skander
associations.relationship: The Prime Skander, from whom Oskander was duplicated.

associations.name: Mad Mary Strazni
associations.relationship: Oskander fell in love with and married Mary Strazni, Yuri's former apprentice.

associations.name: Gertruda
associations.relationship: Oskander's daughter with Mary. He loved Gertruda dearly.

associations.name: Rahadin
associations.relationship: Rahadin murdered Oskander in a fit of rage. The reason for their confrontation is unknown.

name: Oskander
description: Oskander was one of the five duplicates of Yuri Skander. Unlike his brothers who pursued magic and commerce, Oskander fell in love with Mary Strazni — Yuri's young apprentice — and married her. They had a daughter, Gertrude, whom they both loved dearly.
dm_notes:
Oskander was the Skander duplicate who chose love over magic. He married Mary Strazni and they had a daughter, Gertrude. Rahadin murdered Oskander in a fit of rage — nobody is certain what their fight was about or why Rahadin killed him. His death devastated Mary, who eventually left Vallaki and returned to the Village of Barovia with Gertrude, where she became known as Mad Mary.

Once word of Oskander's murder reached the other Skanders, they vowed never to forgive Strahd — the master Rahadin serves. Oskander's death turned the entire Skander family into bitter enemies of Castle Ravenloft.

associations.name: Lady Fiona Wachter
associations.relationship: Nikolai's mother.

associations.name: Karl Wachter
associations.relationship: Nikolai's younger brother.

associations.name: Stella Wachter
associations.relationship: Nikolai's youngest sibling. Killed at the Festival of Light.

associations.name: Elvir Martikov
associations.relationship: Nikolai has feelings for Elvir, Urwin Martikov's youngest daughter. She shares those feelings.

name: Nikolai Wachter Jr.
description: Nikolai Wachter Jr. is Lady Fiona Wachter's eldest son and the heir to Wachterhaus. He is fond of wine and trouble but carries his family name with pride. He commands the militia in the Order of the Silver Dragon contingent.
dm_notes:
Nikolai Jr. is fond of wine and trouble, often found at the Blue Water Inn or about town with his brother Karl. Despite his carousing, he is a capable fighter and commands the Wachter militia contingent in the Order of the Silver Dragon.

At the Festival of Light, Nikolai protected Elvir Martikov — Urwin's youngest daughter — during Strahd's attack. The two have feelings for each other. This connection between the Wachter and Martikov families could prove significant.

Nikolai is aware his mother has her Narfell practices but pays them little mind. He is unaware she keeps his father's preserved corpse in her bedroom.

associations.name: Lady Fiona Wachter
associations.relationship: Karl's mother.

associations.name: Nikolai Wachter Jr.
associations.relationship: Karl's older brother.

associations.name: Stella Wachter
associations.relationship: Karl's younger sister. He tried to protect her but failed.

name: Karl Wachter
description: Karl Wachter is Lady Fiona Wachter's second-born son. A bookworm like his father Nikolai, Karl is quieter and more studious than his older brother. He carries a heavy burden of guilt over his sister Stella's death at the Festival of Light.
dm_notes:
Karl takes after his late father Nikolai Wachter in his love of books and scholarship. He spends time in the Wachterhaus library his father built, continuing the family tradition of historical study.

At the Festival of Light, Karl tried to protect his younger sister Stella from the attacking minions of Lady Williams but was unable to save her. He feels responsible for her death and the guilt weighs heavily on him.

associations.name: Lady Fiona Wachter

name: Stella Wachter
description: Stella Wachter was Lady Fiona Wachter's youngest child and only daughter. She was killed at the Festival of Light during Strahd's attack on Vallaki. Her death shattered her mother's neutrality toward Strahd and turned the Wachter family against the vampire lord.
dm_notes:
Stella was the child most like her mother — she was following in Fiona's Narfell footsteps and was already showing promise as a Demon Master. Fiona saw Stella as her successor in the family's ancient traditions.

At the Festival of Light, Stella was killed by minions of Lady Williams during Strahd's attack. Karl tried to protect her but couldn't save her. Her death broke Fiona — Anna Krezkova had to physically get Fiona moving during the chaos.

description: Urwin Martikov runs the Blue Water Inn in Vallaki with his wife Danika. He is Davian Martikov's son and a member of the Keepers of the Feather — a secret network of wereravens opposed to Strahd.
dm_notes:
Urwin and Danika are both wereravens and members of the Keepers of the Feather. The Blue Water Inn serves as a key intelligence hub for the network. Urwin is protective of his children — Elvir, Brom (17), and Bray (14) — all of whom have inherited the wereraven bloodline.

The entire Martikov family are members of the Keepers of the Feather contingent in the Order of the Silver Dragon and are vowed enemies of Strahd.

name: Kiara Toranescu
description: Kiara Toranescu is the Den Mother of the Barovian werewolf packs — a druid and healer who serves as the spiritual heart of the Den. She is Jiro's grandmother and the mother of the late Den Leader Zuleika. She approaches outsiders peacefully and made a deal with the adventurers on behalf of the Den.
dm_notes:
Kiara is the mother of the late Zuleika Toranescu and wife of Duesius. She has served as Den Mother for decades, tending to the wounded, mediating disputes between packs, and teaching the younger wolves. Like her husband and daughter-in-law Emil, she does not want to continue the war with humans.

When the players came to the Werewolf Den in Session 21, it was Kiara who approached them peacefully with the words 'Be at ease — there is one here who would speak to you.' She and Duesius negotiated a deal with the players on behalf of the Den. After Emil returned from the Wizard's Tower battle, she learned of the deal and chose to honor it.

Kiara is fiercely protective of her grandson Jiro, who has already lost his father and older brothers to human hunters.

name: Duesius Toranescu
description: Duesius Toranescu is Kiara's husband and the grandfather of Jiro. He is very protective of his family and the Den. A grizzled elder werewolf, Duesius carries himself with quiet authority and compassion — especially toward his grandson.
dm_notes:
Duesius is the patriarch of the Toranescu family. He lost his son Zuleika and grandson Ekrol to Elandra Stormraven's assassination plot. Despite this, he does not seek blind revenge — like his wife Kiara, he believes the packs have lost too much already.

Duesius helped negotiate the deal with the players at the Werewolf Den in Session 21. An Insight check reveals the compassion, pride, and humor in his eyes as he watches his grandson Jiro, the last male heir of the Toranescu line.

name: Jiro Toranescu
description: Jiro Toranescu is a young werewolf boy who has suffered tremendous loss — his father Zuleika and older brothers were killed, and his mother Emil was believed dead after the fight at the Wizard's Tower. He is fierce, angry, and heartbroken.
dm_notes:
Jiro lost his father Zuleika and older brothers Ekrol to violence. His mother Emil led the attack on the Wizard's Tower under Elandra's orders and was believed killed when she jumped from a tower window to escape the players. When the players arrived at the Werewolf Den in Session 21, Jiro charged Brother Ivan with a kitchen knife — tears streaking down his face, but hatred and rage in his eyes.

If the players spared Jiro, Kiara explained why the child was angry. Jiro kicked Ivan in the chin before running deeper into the cave.

Unknown to Jiro and the Den at the time, his mother Emil survived the fall and returned after the players left. Jiro is the last young heir of the Toranescu pack and his grandparents are fiercely protective of him.

name: Ekrol Toranescu
description: Ekrol Toranescu was Zuleika's eldest son and a promising young warrior of the Toranescu pack. He died alongside his father when they were ambushed by Elandra Stormraven and Strahd's personal guard, who were disguised as human hunters from Vallaki.
dm_notes: Ekrol fell next to his father Zuleika in the ambush orchestrated by Kiril Stoyanovich, Elandra Stormraven, and Strahd's personal guard. His death, along with his father's, was made to look like the work of human hunters from Vallaki — a lie designed to inflame hatred between the werewolves and humans and justify Kiril's takeover of the Den.
